_comment: Reference values for ase-structure-build (4x4x4 fcc Cu, a=3.615 A). Deterministic construction -> analytic reference values; calibrated on x86_64.
_calibration_note: nn distance = a/sqrt(2) exactly; cell = 4*a. Structure check is a full re-derivation (deterministic), tolerances are the physical minimum resolution for an extxyz round-trip.
